_contract: The committed record of the packing-optimization pilot's MEASURED screen. The full-scorer leg was NOT run: the remaining campaign budget cannot fund it, and §18 says stop rather than silently drop required work.
status: SCREEN COMPLETE; FULL SCORER NOT FUNDED

gate._selection: by measured wall time ALONE; no head-map result is read

findings.packing_not_batch_size: P1 (B2, consecutive) is 1.011x -- nothing. P2 (B2, length-sorted) is 1.158x at the SAME invocation count. The difference between them is padding alone, so what buys the speed is the packing.
findings.b4_failed_on_packing: P3 (B4, length-sorted) is 1.167x FASTER, where B4 consecutive measured 0.6872x on the full scorer. Sorting turns the same batch size from 1.46x slower into 1.17x faster. B4's problem was its packing.
findings.padding_derived_at_zero_dollars: the $0 table predicted it: consecutive B4 pads 36.73% of valid positions, sorted B4 pads 4.50%, sorted B2 pads 1.84%.
findings.screen_is_not_the_adoption_gate: 1.167x clears the 1.10x SCREEN threshold, which only decides what is worth a full scorer. The adoption threshold is 1.25x on the full 28-layer scorer and remains unmeasured.

comparability._consequence: the prior full B1 may NOT serve as the full-run reference, so the remaining chain needs TWO full scorers: a fresh B1 and the candidate.

why_it_stopped.rule: §18 -- if the permitted chain cannot fit the remaining campaign budget, stop rather than silently dropping required work.
why_it_stopped.chain_minutes_required: 100.5 to 109 (setup 3 + parent 22 + fresh full B1 36.5-45 + candidate full 39)
why_it_stopped._what_was_NOT_dropped: the fresh full B1 is required by the predeclared comparability rule; running only the candidate would be dropping it.

to_resume._needs: a new or raised engineering ceiling; ~$2.00 at $1.09/h covers the parent replay and both full scorers.
_reusable: the measured screen (sha256 above), pushable with SCREEN_FROM so it is not re-paid for
the candidate selection: P3, by wall time alone

run the preflight on cuda:0, or pin its thread count from the cgroup quota: nproc reports the host's CPUs, not the container's grant
